Title: Purchased gems or items did not arrive
Summary: What to do when a completed in-game purchase (gems, coins, bundles) does not show up in the player's inventory.
Answer:
Most missing purchases appear within 30 minutes. Ask the player to try these steps in order:

  1. Fully close the game and sign back in with the same account that made the purchase.
  2. Open Store > Restore Purchases (mobile) or Settings > Account > Sync Purchases (PC and console).
  3. Check the platform receipt (PlayStation Store, Xbox, Steam, App Store or Google Play) and confirm the purchase completed and was charged once.
  4. If it still has not arrived after 30 minutes, collect the order or receipt ID, the platform and the purchase time.

If the player was charged but the items are still missing after the steps above, escalate to an advisor with the receipt ID so the purchase can be granted manually.

Title: Refund policy for in-game purchases
Summary: Nova Games refund rules for virtual currency, bundles and accidental purchases.
Answer:
Nova Games can refund a purchase when:

  • It was made in the last 14 days, and
  • The virtual currency or items have not been spent or used.

Purchases made through console or mobile stores are refunded by the store itself (PlayStation, Xbox, Apple or Google). Share the store's refund link with the player.

Chargebacks and disputed payments are handled by the billing team, so always hand these to an advisor.

Title: Reset your password or recover your account
Summary: Steps for players who forgot their password or cannot sign in.
Answer:
1. On the sign-in screen, select Forgot password.
  2. Enter the email address on the Nova Games account. The reset link arrives within 5 minutes; ask the player to check spam.
  3. The link expires after 1 hour. Request a new one if it has expired.
  4. After resetting, turn on two-step verification in Account Settings.

If the player no longer has access to the email on the account, or says someone else changed it, do not troubleshoot: treat it as an account security case and hand it to an advisor.

Title: Account compromised or email changed without permission
Summary: Advisor procedure for hacked accounts. AI agents must escalate these to a human.
Answer:
AI agents: always escalate these to a human advisor.

Advisor steps:

  1. Verify ownership: the original account email, the player ID, and the date and platform of the last purchase.
  2. Lock the account to stop further changes.
  3. Restore the original email and force a password reset.
  4. Review recent purchases and trades. Reverse unauthorised activity and note it on the case.
  5. Turn on two-step verification with the player while they are still in the chat.
  6. Close the case with resolution notes. Set Priority to High if purchases were made.

Title: Game crashes on launch
Summary: Troubleshooting for crashes at start-up on PC, console and mobile.
Answer:
1. Install the latest game update and restart the device.
  2. PC: update graphics drivers, then verify the game files in the launcher (Steam: right-click the game > Properties > Installed Files > Verify).
  3. Console: clear the reserved space or cache, then restart.
  4. Mobile: free at least 2 GB of storage and clear the app cache.
  5. If it still crashes, collect the platform, device model and any error code, and hand it to an advisor.

Title: Cannot connect to game servers
Summary: Fixes for disconnects, lag and 'unable to reach server' errors.
Answer:
1. Check the server status page for outages or maintenance.
  2. Restart the router and the device. Switch to a wired connection if possible.
  3. Make sure the console or PC is not on a VPN or proxy.
  4. Set NAT type to Open (console) or allow the game through the firewall (PC).

If there is no outage and the problem continues for more than 24 hours, collect the error code and hand it to an advisor.
